recent_en: PJBumi has proposed a private placement of up to 10% new shares and obtained Bursa approval for a 1-for-5 share split. The company also announced a collaboration with H3 Dynamics to develop hydrogen-powered UAVs. Latest quarter (ended June 2026) saw significant growth in revenue and net profit.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares to raise about RM31m.
Bursa has approved the proposed 1-for-5 share split.
Collaboration with H3 Dynamics to develop hydrogen-powered UAVs.
risks_en: The private placement may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
The share split still requires shareholder approval at an EGM.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was RM2.135m, up 53.6% QoQ and 907.1% YoY; net profit was RM1.109m, up 746.6% QoQ, with net margin rising from 9.4% to 51.9%.
